from: Events are points; worldlines are curves. The light cone at any event divides spacetime into timelike future/past (inside the cone), spacelike elsewhere (outside), and lightlike (on the cone). Lorentz transformations act as hyperbolic rotations that keep cones fixed and shear constant-time slices; that is why simultaneity changes but light speed does not.

from: Ereignisse sind Punkte, Weltlinien Kurven.
